test_command: cmake --build build --config Debug --target test_exe > $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Set-Location build/bin/Debug; ./test_exe.exe --gtest_filter=ListCursorTest.*:StepWithinTest.*

mutations.original: return magnitude >= highest - value ? highest : value + magnitude;
mutations.catches: the high clamp dropped, so a step past the bound overshoots it
the low clamp dropped, so a step below zero wraps to a huge row
the wheel bound back at the last row, so the list scrolls until one row shows
down allowed from the last row
the stored scroll read unclamped, so a screen bigger than the list still scrolls
a click reads the stale scroll position after a shrink
the place one below the last row, and row 0 of an empty list, read as rows
up past the top leaves the cursor one row above the screen
down past the bottom scrolls one row too few, leaving the cursor below the screen
a step down keeps a scroll position a shrink left above the drawn screen, so the list draws from row 1 once it grows again
the wheel starts from the stale stored scroll after a shrink, so a notch back moves nothing (Release) or aborts on step_within's bound (Debug)
a delete of the current last row leaves the cursor past the end
emptying and refilling the list keeps the old scroll, so the cursor on row 0 is drawn off screen
a reset keeps the old current row
a reset keeps the old scroll position
